headline: Sklepy w grudniu staną na cztery dni. Ministra zabiera głos
summary: Poland's labour minister Agnieszka Dziemianowicz-Bąk confirmed that 27 December 2026 will not be a trading Sunday. Shops will be open on three Sundays before Christmas but closed after Christmas Eve until Monday.
why: Trading-day restrictions affect retail sales volumes and the revenue of large chains such as Poland's supermarket and department store operators during the peak season.
